bands.label: OT-1.25X
bands.take_hours: (normal_hours + hours_beyond_normal > limits.normal_day ? hours_beyond_normal - (limits.normal_day > normal_hours ? limits.normal_day - normal_hours : 0.0) : 0.0)

limits.authority: 労働基準法 §32(2): 一日について八時間を超えて、労働させてはならない
労働基準法 §32(1): 一週間について四十時間を超えて、労働させてはならない
労働基準法 §36(3)–(4): the 36協定 限度時間 of 45 hours a month (a reported ceiling; a special clause may exceed it in up to six months)
労働基準法 §36(4): 限度時間 of 360 hours a year (a reported ceiling)
労働基準法 §36(5): even under a special clause, overtime of at most 720 hours a year
労働基準法 §36(6)(ii): overtime plus statutory holiday work under 100 hours in a month (百時間未満; the ceiling report counts 100 itself as within)

wages.authority: 最低賃金法 §9–§10 and §4(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334AC0000000137): each prefecture's 地域別最低賃金 is an hourly amount binding the work performed at a workplace in that prefecture (§13: a dispatched worker takes the client workplace's). `by_region` holds that hourly amount per prefecture, read at the worksite the terms record (`workplace_keyed`); `scale` restates it in the contract's month — 最低賃金法施行規則 §2(1)(iii) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334M50002000016) divides a monthly wage by the month's scheduled hours, or by the annual average monthly scheduled hours where months differ, so the hourly floor × annual scheduled hours ÷ 12 is the month's floor; a daily or hourly rate reaches the same comparison through `terms.monthly_basic` on the ordinary divisor. §4(2): a contract below the floor is void to that extent and the floor applies in its place (`substitutes_below`). The comparison wage is the scheduled pay (施行規則 §1; MHLW https://saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp/point/page_point_targetwages.html: bonuses, overtime/holiday/night premiums and commuting, family and attendance allowances are outside it) — the fixed allowances count (`floor_includes_fixed_allowances`) until an allowance catalogue names the excluded classes. Amounts and 発効日: MHLW H14–R8 workbook (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/11200000/001753407.xlsx) and MHLW's quick table (https://saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp/table/page_list_nationallist.php, read 2026-09-30); the workbook prints six 令和7年度 dates with the previous year (秋田 03-31, 福島/徳島/大分/熊本 01-01, 群馬 03-01), the quick table prints 令和8 for each. 令和8年度 successors: MHLW national list (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/11200000/001753404.pdf) and the quick table (“令和8.MM.DDからは”). 特定最低賃金 (work_rules.derived_lines SPECIFIC_MINIMUM_WAGE): 最低賃金法 §6(1) — where a worker is under both a regional and a specific minimum wage the higher binds; §4(2) substitutes it for a lower contract term. The SPECIFIC_MW row of the worksite’s prefecture and recorded industry (worksite_facts.specific_mw_industry) gives an hourly amount; restated in the month over the annual scheduled hours (施行規則 §2(1)(iii), as the regional floor), the month’s wage (basic already raised to the regional floor, plus the fixed allowances) is topped up to it in the share of the month the salary line pays. Covered ages and the order’s own exclusions (terms_facts.specific_mw_excluded) are read per row; the recorded default is 18 to under 65, the usual 適用除外 of MHLW’s decisions.

work_rules.authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §32: normal hours are at most 40 a week and 8 a day (`normal_hours`, limits `normal_day` and `weekly_normal`). §37(1) with 労働基準法第三十七条第一項の時間外及び休日の割増賃金に係る率の最低限度を定める政令 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/406CO0000000005): hours beyond the statutory day are paid at least 25% above the ordinary hourly wage, and work on the §35 statutory rest day at least 35% — a REST code marked `statutory` is that day (`statutory_rest`); its hours are holiday work, never overtime. §37(4): 22:00–05:00 adds at least 25% on top (`night_premium`), so night overtime is 50% and night holiday work 60%. Hours past the contract's shorter scheduled day up to the statutory 8 (法内残業) owe the ordinary rate only (`IN-LAW-1.0X`). Owner rule 2026-09-28, law silent: work on a non-statutory rest day, a national holiday or an unrostered day is treated as outside a full 40-hour week and paid at 125% — never below §37, although a short week would owe 100% for hours still inside 40. §41(2): a 管理監督者 (work_classification SUPERVISORY_MANAGER) is outside the hours, rest and overtime/holiday rules (`overtime_when`), not the night premium. §36(4)–(6): the 36協定 ordinary limits 45 h a month and 360 h a year, and the absolute limits 720 h a year of overtime and under 100 h a month of overtime plus statutory holiday work, are reported ceilings here (planned hours beyond them are kept, paid at the same band, as INCENTIVE), not refusals. 施行規則 §19(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322M40000100023): a monthly wage's hourly rate is the wage ÷ the month's scheduled hours, or the annual average monthly scheduled hours where months differ: `ordinary_divisor_days` spreads the month over annual scheduled hours ÷ 12 ÷ the daily hours. Rounding: MHLW 昭和63年3月14日 基発第150号 (as restated https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/yamaguchi-roudoukyoku/content/contents/001988747.pdf) tolerates rounding the hourly rate and each premium amount at 50 銭 (under 50 銭 down, 50 銭 and over up); the bands price on the hourly rate rounded to the yen (`round(x, 1, 'HALF_UP')`), and every yen line rounds half-up at JPY's minor unit (通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 §3, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/362AC0000000042).

derived_lines.when: has(worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry) && table('SPECIFIC_MW', worksite.region, worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry) != null && terms.monthly_basic > 0.0 && double(employee.age) >= double(table('SPECIFIC_MW', worksite.region, worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry).covered_from_age) && double(employee.age) < double(table('SPECIFIC_MW', worksite.region, worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry).covered_below_age) && !terms.facts.specific_mw_excluded

final_pay_deadlines.authority: 労働基準法 §23(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049): on the death or retirement of a worker, wages are paid within seven days of the entitled person's request. The statute counts from the request; the recorded default (owner rule 2026-09-28) counts from the last day, the earliest a request can be made, so the warning is never late. Without a request the ordinary §24 pay day applies.

worksite_coverage.authority: 最低賃金法 §9, §13 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334AC0000000137): the regional minimum wage is set per prefecture and binds work at a workplace there; a worksite must name one of the 47 prefectures `work_rules.wages.by_region` keys, or payroll refuses.

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation on e-Gov 法令検索, the 官報, or the table the ministry or labour bureau itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date.
laws.e-gov.go.jp — 法令検索: /law/<法令ID> is the current text with its amendment history. IDs: 労働基準法 322AC0000000049, 労働基準法施行規則 322M40000100023, 割増賃金率の政令 406CO0000000005, 最低賃金法 334AC0000000137, 最低賃金法施行規則 334M50002000016, 所得税法 340AC0000000033, 通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 362AC0000000042.
mhlw.go.jp / saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp / jsite.mhlw.go.jp — 最低賃金: the H14–R8 workbook (content/11200000/001753407.xlsx), the 令和8年度 national list (001753404.pdf), the quick table /table/page_list_nationallist.php (current amount, 発効日, and “からは” the next); each prefectural labour bureau publishes its own decision and 官報公示 date.
nta.go.jp — 源泉徴収: taxanswer/gensen/2511 (税額表の区分), /publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo<year>/ (the year's tables).

Finding changes (every run): each August–September read MHLW's 地域別最低賃金 答申 release and the quick table; a 答申 amount is pending until the prefectural director's decision is published (最低賃金法 §14(2): effective 30 days after publication, or later as stated). Read e-Gov's 新着 (laws.e-gov.go.jp) for 労働基準法 and its 施行規則. Every December read nta.go.jp for the next year's 源泉徴収税額表.
kyoukaikenpo.or.jp / nenkin.go.jp — 社会保険: 協会けんぽ's 保険料額表 workbook for the year (/assets/r<N>ippan3.xlsx; branch rates, care rate, the 50 grades and the rounding and bonus notes), JPS 保険料額表 (/service/kounen/hokenryo/ryogaku/ryogakuhyo/) for 厚生年金 and 拠出金, こども家庭庁 for the 子ども・子育て支援金 rate. Each February read the next 年度's 協会けんぽ rates (they apply from the March insurance month, collected with April pay) and the 支援金 rate for April; a version's rates are those of the insurance month its pay months collect.

facts.label: 雇用保険の事業の種類 (employment-insurance rate class)
facts.description: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(4) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084); MHLW 雇用保険料率 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001692566.pdf): GENERAL 一般の事業; AGRICULTURE_SAKE 農林水産・清酒製造の事業; CONSTRUCTION 建設の事業. 園芸サービス、牛馬の育成、酪農、養鶏、養豚、内水面養殖 and a business employing 特定の船員 take the GENERAL rate. Record the class the 労働保険 保険関係成立届 established; payroll refuses an employment-insurance premium without it.

facts.label: 労災保険率表の事業の種類の番号 (workers’ compensation business type)
facts.description: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律施行規則 別表第一 労災保険率表 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/347M50002000008; MHLW table https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/rousaihokenritu_r05.pdf, 令和6年4月1日施行, unchanged for 令和7・8年度): the 事業の種類の番号 of this establishment’s labour-insurance relationship. 02 林業（木材伐出業） 52/1,000; 03 その他の林業 52/1,000; 11 海面漁業（定置網漁業又は海面魚類養殖業を除く。） 18/1,000; 12 定置網漁業又は海面魚類養殖業 37/1,000; 21 金属鉱業、非金属鉱業（石灰石鉱業又はドロマイト鉱業を除く。）又は石炭鉱業 88/1,000; 23 石灰石鉱業又はドロマイト鉱業 13/1,000; 24 原油又は天然ガス鉱業 2.5/1,000; 25 採石業 37/1,000; 26 その他の鉱業 26/1,000; 31 水力発電施設、ずい道等新設事業 34/1,000; 32 道路新設事業 11/1,000; 33 舗装工事業 9/1,000; 34 鉄道又は軌道新設事業 9/1,000; 35 建築事業（既設建築物設備工事業を除く。） 9.5/1,000; 38 既設建築物設備工事業 12/1,000; 36 機械装置の組立て又は据付けの事業 6/1,000; 37 その他の建設事業 15/1,000; 41 食料品製造業 5.5/1,000; 42 繊維工業又は繊維製品製造業 4/1,000; 44 木材又は木製品製造業 13/1,000; 45 パルプ又は紙製造業 7/1,000; 46 印刷又は製本業 3.5/1,000; 47 化学工業 4.5/1,000; 48 ガラス又はセメント製造業 6/1,000; 66 コンクリート製造業 13/1,000; 62 陶磁器製品製造業 17/1,000; 49 その他の窯業又は土石製品製造業 23/1,000; 50 金属精錬業（非鉄金属精錬業を除く。） 6.5/1,000; 51 非鉄金属精錬業 7/1,000; 52 金属材料品製造業（鋳物業を除く。） 5/1,000; 53 鋳物業 16/1,000; 54 金属製品製造業又は金属加工業（洋食器、刃物、手工具又は一般金物製造業及びめつき業を除く。） 9/1,000; 63 洋食器、刃物、手工具又は一般金物製造業（めつき業を除く。） 6.5/1,000; 55 めつき業 6.5/1,000; 56 機械器具製造業（電気機械器具製造業、輸送用機械器具製造業、船舶製造又は修理業及び計量器、光学機械、時計等製造業を除く。） 5/1,000; 57 電気機械器具製造業 3/1,000; 58 輸送用機械器具製造業（船舶製造又は修理業を除く。） 4/1,000; 59 船舶製造又は修理業 23/1,000; 60 計量器、光学機械、時計等製造業（電気機械器具製造業を除く。） 2.5/1,000; 64 貴金属製品、装身具、皮革製品等製造業 3.5/1,000; 61 その他の製造業 6/1,000; 71 交通運輸事業 4/1,000; 72 貨物取扱事業（港湾貨物取扱事業及び港湾荷役業を除く。） 8.5/1,000; 73 港湾貨物取扱事業（港湾荷役業を除く。） 9/1,000; 74 港湾荷役業 12/1,000; 81 電気、ガス、水道又は熱供給の事業 3/1,000; 95 農業又は海面漁業以外の漁業 13/1,000; 91 清掃、火葬又はと畜の事業 13/1,000; 93 ビルメンテナンス業 6/1,000; 96 倉庫業、警備業、消毒又は害虫駆除の事業又はゴルフ場の事業 6.5/1,000; 97 通信業、放送業、新聞業又は出版業 2.5/1,000; 98 卸売業・小売業、飲食店又は宿泊業 3/1,000; 99 金融業、保険業又は不動産業 2.5/1,000; 94 その他の各種事業 3/1,000; 90 船舶所有者の事業 42/1,000. Workers’ compensation is compulsory for every business employing a worker (労働者災害補償保険法 §3), so payroll refuses without it.

facts.label: メリット制による労災保険率 (per 1,000, as notified)
facts.description: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(3) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): for a qualifying business the Minister raises or lowers the 労災保険率 within ±40% by its own benefit record. Record the rate per 1,000 the 労働局 notified for the 保険年度, only when one was notified; otherwise the table rate of the business type applies.

facts.label: 電算機計算の特例 (月額表甲欄)
facts.description: 平成24年財務省告示第116号 (https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/data/18.pdf): true where the payer computes monthly 甲欄 withholding by the 電子計算機等 method instead of reading the 月額表; the difference is settled at the 年末調整.

facts.label: 36協定 特別条項
facts.description: 労働基準法 §36(5): a 36協定 with a special clause may exceed the 45-hour month and 360-hour year 限度時間 in up to six months a year, within 720 hours a year and under 100 hours a month with statutory-holiday work (§36(6)). Unrecorded is no special clause.

terms_facts.label: 年間所定労働時間 (annual scheduled hours)
terms_facts.description: 労働基準法施行規則 §19(1)(iv) and 最低賃金法施行規則 §2(1)(iii): a monthly wage's hourly rate is the wage over the month's scheduled hours, or the annual average monthly scheduled hours where the months differ — the contract's scheduled hours for the year, net of breaks, scheduled rest days and holidays (e.g. 2,064). The ordinary divisor and the minimum-wage month both read it ÷ 12; no default stands in for it.

terms_facts.label: 源泉徴収税額表の欄 (甲/乙/丙)
terms_facts.description: 所得税法 §185(1) and §194 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2511.htm): KOU (甲欄) only where the worker filed the 給与所得者の扶養控除等（異動）申告書 with this payer; HEI (丙欄) for 日雇賃金 — daily-paid work of at most two months' continuous employment; otherwise OTSU (乙欄). Unrecorded is no declaration: OTSU, the statute's column for a payer without the declaration.

terms_facts.label: 扶養親族等の数
terms_facts.description: The number of 源泉控除対象配偶者 and 控除対象扶養親族 the 扶養控除等申告書 declares, plus one for each disability, widow/single-parent or working-student status the table's notes add (NTA 月額表 備考). Required with KOU.

terms_facts.label: 住民税の徴収方法
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-3–§321-5: an employer designated by the municipality special-collects (SPECIAL, 特別徴収) the resident tax the municipality notifies, one twelfth a month from June to the following May; ORDINARY (普通徴収) where the municipality notice leaves collection to the worker. Record from the municipality's 特別徴収税額の決定通知書 (e.g. https://www.city.shinjuku.lg.jp/hoken/file04_04_00001.html).

terms_facts.label: 住民税 6月分 (最初の徴収月の額)
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-5(1), §20-4-2(6), (8): the first installment the notice states — June for the ordinary notice (a later notice: its resident_tax_first_month); it carries the fractions under JPY100 of the annual amount, so it differs from the rest. A new terms row each June carries the next notice.

terms_facts.label: 住民税 7月分以降
terms_facts.description: The installment of every later month to May the same notice states (7月分以降 for the ordinary notice).

terms_facts.label: 特別徴収税額通知 (municipality, fiscal year)
terms_facts.description: The notifying municipality and 年度 of the notice the two amounts transcribe.

terms_facts.label: 住民税 特別徴収税額通知の年度 (西暦)
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-4, §321-5(1): the 年度 of the notice as a Gregorian year (令和8年度 = 2026): its installments are withheld from pay paid from June of that year to May of the next. Payroll refuses a pay date outside it.

terms_facts.label: 住民税 最初の徴収月
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-5(1): 6 for the ordinary May notice; for a notice received later (a joiner switching to special collection, a changed amount) the month after the notice, from which its first installment (resident_tax_june_amount) and then resident_tax_monthly_amount run to May.

terms_facts.label: 通勤: 1か月当たりの合理的な運賃等の額
terms_facts.description: 所得税法施行令 §20の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2582.htm): the monthly fare of the most economic and reasonable transit route (定期券 equivalent); 0 where the worker does not commute by transit. The untaxed 通勤手当 is at most JPY150,000 a month.

terms_facts.label: 通勤: 交通用具を使用する片道の通勤距離 (km)
terms_facts.description: 所得税法施行令 §20の2(2) (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm): the one-way distance commuted by car, bicycle or other vehicle; under 2 km the vehicle part is taxable. Unrecorded is no vehicle commute.

terms_facts.label: 通勤: 駐車場等の1か月当たりの料金
terms_facts.description: 令和8年度税制改正 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm): from allowances due 1 April 2026, the monthly fee the worker ordinarily bears for a qualifying parking place near the workplace or the station used, added to the vehicle limit up to JPY5,000.

terms_facts.label: 社宅・寮の貸与 (employee)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-41, 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): true where the employer lets company housing to this employee (not an 役員, not a cash housing allowance, which is plain pay).

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 建物の固定資産税の課税標準額 (その年度)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the building’s 固定資産税課税標準額 for the year, also where the employer leases it.

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 建物の総床面積 (m²)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the building’s total floor area.

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 敷地の固定資産税の課税標準額 (その年度)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the site’s 固定資産税課税標準額 for the year.

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 使用人から受け取る家賃 (月額)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-47 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the monthly rent the employee pays; at least 50% of the 賃貸料相当額 leaves the housing untaxed, less is taxed on the difference.

terms_facts.label: 要介護状態の対象家族の数
terms_facts.description: 育児・介護休業法 §16-5(1): the 対象家族 in a 要介護状態 the worker cares for; two or more give 10 介護休暇 days a year instead of 5. Unrecorded is none.

terms_facts.label: 特定最低賃金の適用除外 (outside the specific minimum wage’s coverage)
terms_facts.description: Each 特定最低賃金 decision names the workers it does not cover beyond its age bounds (the SPECIFIC_MW row’s columns): typically those within a stated period after hire learning the skill (雇入れ後一定期間未満の技能習得中の者) and those mainly doing the light tasks it lists (清掃・片付け等). Record true where the decision’s own exclusion reaches this worker; unrecorded is covered (the recorded default: the order applies to the industry’s workers). Only the regional floor then binds.

obligations.description: Conclude a written 時間外・休日労働に関する協定 (36協定) with the majority union or majority representative and file it with the labour standards office before any overtime or statutory holiday work; renew it before it lapses.
obligations.trigger: Any planned overtime beyond 8 h/day or 40 h/week, or work on the statutory rest day
obligations.timing: Before the first such hour; the agreement's period (at most a year in practice) sets renewal
obligations.authority: 労働基準法 §36(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049)

obligations.description: Where a worker’s annual paid leave grant is 10 days or more, designate the timing of 5 of those days (after hearing the worker) within one year of the grant date, less the days the worker took or planned leave gave; keep the 年次有給休暇管理簿 (timing, days, base date per worker) for the grant period and five years after.
obligations.trigger: An ANNUAL_LEAVE grant of 10 days or more; the grant date is the hire day and each hire anniversary (the recorded 前倒し default)
obligations.timing: Within one year of each grant date; the register kept five years after the grant period (three during the transition)
obligations.authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §39(7)–(8); 労働基準法施行規則 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322M40000100023) §24-5, §24-6, §24-7

exit_facts.label: 退職時の賃金支払請求
exit_facts.description: 労働基準法 §23(1): true where the worker (or, on death, the entitled person) requested payment of the wages due; they are then payable within seven days. Unrecorded is no request: the ordinary pay day.

exit_facts.label: 退職所得の受給に関する申告書
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §201(1), (3) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2732.htm): true where the worker submitted the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 before the retirement payment, so the payer withholds on the 退職所得控除 and the 1/2 rules; unrecorded is none, and §201(3) withholds 20.42% of the whole payment.

exit_facts.label: 退職所得控除の勤続年数
exit_facts.description: 所得税法施行令 §69 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340CO0000000096): the service years the 退職所得控除 reads — continuous service to the retirement day, with the §69(1)(i)イ–ハ additions (earlier service with this payer, service elsewhere this payer’s allowance counts) and exclusions (a period an earlier allowance from this payer settled); a part year is one year. Unrecorded is this stint from its first day through the last, a part year one year.

exit_facts.label: 役員等勤続年数
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(5) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 施行令 §69の2: the years served as an 役員等 (法人税法 §2(xv) officer, legislator, public servant). Five or less over the whole service makes the payment a 特定役員退職手当等 (no halving). 0 for an employee.

exit_facts.label: 障害者になったことに直接基因する退職
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(6)(iii); 施行令 §71: true where the worker became disabled while employed and retired having worked not at all or hardly since; adds JPY1,000,000 to the 退職所得控除.

exit_facts.label: 退職所得控除の調整年数 (前の退職手当等との重複期間)
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(6)(i); 施行令 §70 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340CO0000000096; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2732.htm): the years whose deduction is taken off — the service an earlier allowance counted into this one (§70(1)(i)), or the overlap with an allowance received in the previous four years (nine years for an allowance received from 1 January 2026 where a 確定拠出年金 lump sum from 2026 was received in the previous nine; nineteen years for a DC lump sum paid this year), each fraction of a year dropped (§70(3)) and shortened by §70(2) where that allowance fell short of its own deduction. As the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 states.

exit_facts.description: 地方税法 §50-2, §328 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226): the 退職所得割 is levied by the municipality and prefecture of the address on 1 January of the year the allowance is payable; false where the worker had no address in Japan that day (none is withheld). exit_facts.label: 住民税 特別徴収の退職時の取扱い
exit_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-5(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226; Yokohama https://www.city.yokohama.lg.jp/kurashi/koseki-zei-hoken/zeikin/jigyosya/shizei/choshu/kirikaeiraisyo.html): LUMP_SUM withholds the remaining installments to May in one amount from the final pay where it exceeds them (the worker’s request from June to December; required from January to April); TRANSFER where the new employer continues the special collection (特別徴収継続); ORDINARY where the rest passes to 普通徴収 (June–December only). Unrecorded is no request from June to December and LUMP_SUM from January to April. File the 給与所得者異動届出書 by the tenth of the next month either way.

bands.take_hours: (normal_hours + hours_beyond_normal > limits.normal_day ? hours_beyond_normal - (limits.normal_day > normal_hours ? limits.normal_day - normal_hours : 0.0) : 0.0)

limits.authority: 労働基準法 §32(2): 一日について八時間を超えて、労働させてはならない
労働基準法 §32(1): 一週間について四十時間を超えて、労働させてはならない
労働基準法 §36(3)–(4): the 36協定 限度時間 of 45 hours a month (a reported ceiling; a special clause may exceed it in up to six months)
労働基準法 §36(4): 限度時間 of 360 hours a year (a reported ceiling)
労働基準法 §36(5): even under a special clause, overtime of at most 720 hours a year
労働基準法 §36(6)(ii): overtime plus statutory holiday work under 100 hours in a month (百時間未満; the ceiling report counts 100 itself as within)

wages.authority: 最低賃金法 §9–§10 and §4(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334AC0000000137): each prefecture's 地域別最低賃金 is an hourly amount binding the work performed at a workplace in that prefecture (§13: a dispatched worker takes the client workplace's). `by_region` holds that hourly amount per prefecture, read at the worksite the terms record (`workplace_keyed`); `scale` restates it in the contract's month — 最低賃金法施行規則 §2(1)(iii) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334M50002000016) divides a monthly wage by the month's scheduled hours, or by the annual average monthly scheduled hours where months differ, so the hourly floor × annual scheduled hours ÷ 12 is the month's floor; a daily or hourly rate reaches the same comparison through `terms.monthly_basic` on the ordinary divisor. §4(2): a contract below the floor is void to that extent and the floor applies in its place (`substitutes_below`). The comparison wage is the scheduled pay (施行規則 §1; MHLW https://saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp/point/page_point_targetwages.html: bonuses, overtime/holiday/night premiums and commuting, family and attendance allowances are outside it) — the fixed allowances count (`floor_includes_fixed_allowances`) until an allowance catalogue names the excluded classes. Amounts and 発効日: MHLW H14–R8 workbook (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/11200000/001753407.xlsx) and MHLW's quick table (https://saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp/table/page_list_nationallist.php, read 2026-09-30); the workbook prints six 令和7年度 dates with the previous year (秋田 03-31, 福島/徳島/大分/熊本 01-01, 群馬 03-01), the quick table prints 令和8 for each. 令和8年度 successors: MHLW national list (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/11200000/001753404.pdf) and the quick table (“令和8.MM.DDからは”). 特定最低賃金 (work_rules.derived_lines SPECIFIC_MINIMUM_WAGE): 最低賃金法 §6(1) — where a worker is under both a regional and a specific minimum wage the higher binds; §4(2) substitutes it for a lower contract term. The SPECIFIC_MW row of the worksite’s prefecture and recorded industry (worksite_facts.specific_mw_industry) gives an hourly amount; restated in the month over the annual scheduled hours (施行規則 §2(1)(iii), as the regional floor), the month’s wage (basic already raised to the regional floor, plus the fixed allowances) is topped up to it in the share of the month the salary line pays. Covered ages and the order’s own exclusions (terms_facts.specific_mw_excluded) are read per row; the recorded default is 18 to under 65, the usual 適用除外 of MHLW’s decisions.

work_rules.authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §32: normal hours are at most 40 a week and 8 a day (`normal_hours`, limits `normal_day` and `weekly_normal`). §37(1) with 労働基準法第三十七条第一項の時間外及び休日の割増賃金に係る率の最低限度を定める政令 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/406CO0000000005): hours beyond the statutory day are paid at least 25% above the ordinary hourly wage, and work on the §35 statutory rest day at least 35% — a REST code marked `statutory` is that day (`statutory_rest`); its hours are holiday work, never overtime. §37(4): 22:00–05:00 adds at least 25% on top (`night_premium`), so night overtime is 50% and night holiday work 60%. Hours past the contract's shorter scheduled day up to the statutory 8 (法内残業) owe the ordinary rate only (`IN-LAW-1.0X`). Owner rule 2026-09-28, law silent: work on a non-statutory rest day, a national holiday or an unrostered day is treated as outside a full 40-hour week and paid at 125% — never below §37, although a short week would owe 100% for hours still inside 40. §41(2): a 管理監督者 (work_classification SUPERVISORY_MANAGER) is outside the hours, rest and overtime/holiday rules (`overtime_when`), not the night premium. §36(4)–(6): the 36協定 ordinary limits 45 h a month and 360 h a year, and the absolute limits 720 h a year of overtime and under 100 h a month of overtime plus statutory holiday work, are reported ceilings here (planned hours beyond them are kept, paid at the same band, as INCENTIVE), not refusals. 施行規則 §19(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322M40000100023): a monthly wage's hourly rate is the wage ÷ the month's scheduled hours, or the annual average monthly scheduled hours where months differ: `ordinary_divisor_days` spreads the month over annual scheduled hours ÷ 12 ÷ the daily hours. Rounding: MHLW 昭和63年3月14日 基発第150号 (as restated https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/yamaguchi-roudoukyoku/content/contents/001988747.pdf) tolerates rounding the hourly rate and each premium amount at 50 銭 (under 50 銭 down, 50 銭 and over up); the bands price on the hourly rate rounded to the yen (`round(x, 1, 'HALF_UP')`), and every yen line rounds half-up at JPY's minor unit (通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 §3, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/362AC0000000042).

derived_lines.when: has(worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry) && table('SPECIFIC_MW', worksite.region, worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry) != null && terms.monthly_basic > 0.0 && double(employee.age) >= double(table('SPECIFIC_MW', worksite.region, worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry).covered_from_age) && double(employee.age) < double(table('SPECIFIC_MW', worksite.region, worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry).covered_below_age) && !terms.facts.specific_mw_excluded

final_pay_deadlines.authority: 労働基準法 §23(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049): on the death or retirement of a worker, wages are paid within seven days of the entitled person's request. The statute counts from the request; the recorded default (owner rule 2026-09-28) counts from the last day, the earliest a request can be made, so the warning is never late. Without a request the ordinary §24 pay day applies.

worksite_coverage.authority: 最低賃金法 §9, §13 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334AC0000000137): the regional minimum wage is set per prefecture and binds work at a workplace there; a worksite must name one of the 47 prefectures `work_rules.wages.by_region` keys, or payroll refuses.

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation on e-Gov 法令検索, the 官報, or the table the ministry or labour bureau itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date.
laws.e-gov.go.jp — 法令検索: /law/<法令ID> is the current text with its amendment history. IDs: 労働基準法 322AC0000000049, 労働基準法施行規則 322M40000100023, 割増賃金率の政令 406CO0000000005, 最低賃金法 334AC0000000137, 最低賃金法施行規則 334M50002000016, 所得税法 340AC0000000033, 通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 362AC0000000042.
mhlw.go.jp / saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp / jsite.mhlw.go.jp — 最低賃金: the H14–R8 workbook (content/11200000/001753407.xlsx), the 令和8年度 national list (001753404.pdf), the quick table /table/page_list_nationallist.php (current amount, 発効日, and “からは” the next); each prefectural labour bureau publishes its own decision and 官報公示 date.
nta.go.jp — 源泉徴収: taxanswer/gensen/2511 (税額表の区分), /publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo<year>/ (the year's tables).

Finding changes (every run): each August–September read MHLW's 地域別最低賃金 答申 release and the quick table; a 答申 amount is pending until the prefectural director's decision is published (最低賃金法 §14(2): effective 30 days after publication, or later as stated). Read e-Gov's 新着 (laws.e-gov.go.jp) for 労働基準法 and its 施行規則. Every December read nta.go.jp for the next year's 源泉徴収税額表.
kyoukaikenpo.or.jp / nenkin.go.jp — 社会保険: 協会けんぽ's 保険料額表 workbook for the year (/assets/r<N>ippan3.xlsx; branch rates, care rate, the 50 grades and the rounding and bonus notes), JPS 保険料額表 (/service/kounen/hokenryo/ryogaku/ryogakuhyo/) for 厚生年金 and 拠出金, こども家庭庁 for the 子ども・子育て支援金 rate. Each February read the next 年度's 協会けんぽ rates (they apply from the March insurance month, collected with April pay) and the 支援金 rate for April; a version's rates are those of the insurance month its pay months collect.

facts.description: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(4) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084); MHLW 雇用保険料率 (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/001692566.pdf): GENERAL 一般の事業; AGRICULTURE_SAKE 農林水産・清酒製造の事業; CONSTRUCTION 建設の事業. 園芸サービス、牛馬の育成、酪農、養鶏、養豚、内水面養殖 and a business employing 特定の船員 take the GENERAL rate. Record the class the 労働保険 保険関係成立届 established; payroll refuses an employment-insurance premium without it.

facts.label: 労災保険率表の事業の種類の番号 (workers’ compensation business type)
facts.description: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律施行規則 別表第一 労災保険率表 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/347M50002000008; MHLW table https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/rousaihokenritu_r05.pdf, 令和6年4月1日施行, unchanged for 令和7・8年度): the 事業の種類の番号 of this establishment’s labour-insurance relationship. 02 林業（木材伐出業） 52/1,000; 03 その他の林業 52/1,000; 11 海面漁業（定置網漁業又は海面魚類養殖業を除く。） 18/1,000; 12 定置網漁業又は海面魚類養殖業 37/1,000; 21 金属鉱業、非金属鉱業（石灰石鉱業又はドロマイト鉱業を除く。）又は石炭鉱業 88/1,000; 23 石灰石鉱業又はドロマイト鉱業 13/1,000; 24 原油又は天然ガス鉱業 2.5/1,000; 25 採石業 37/1,000; 26 その他の鉱業 26/1,000; 31 水力発電施設、ずい道等新設事業 34/1,000; 32 道路新設事業 11/1,000; 33 舗装工事業 9/1,000; 34 鉄道又は軌道新設事業 9/1,000; 35 建築事業（既設建築物設備工事業を除く。） 9.5/1,000; 38 既設建築物設備工事業 12/1,000; 36 機械装置の組立て又は据付けの事業 6/1,000; 37 その他の建設事業 15/1,000; 41 食料品製造業 5.5/1,000; 42 繊維工業又は繊維製品製造業 4/1,000; 44 木材又は木製品製造業 13/1,000; 45 パルプ又は紙製造業 7/1,000; 46 印刷又は製本業 3.5/1,000; 47 化学工業 4.5/1,000; 48 ガラス又はセメント製造業 6/1,000; 66 コンクリート製造業 13/1,000; 62 陶磁器製品製造業 17/1,000; 49 その他の窯業又は土石製品製造業 23/1,000; 50 金属精錬業（非鉄金属精錬業を除く。） 6.5/1,000; 51 非鉄金属精錬業 7/1,000; 52 金属材料品製造業（鋳物業を除く。） 5/1,000; 53 鋳物業 16/1,000; 54 金属製品製造業又は金属加工業（洋食器、刃物、手工具又は一般金物製造業及びめつき業を除く。） 9/1,000; 63 洋食器、刃物、手工具又は一般金物製造業（めつき業を除く。） 6.5/1,000; 55 めつき業 6.5/1,000; 56 機械器具製造業（電気機械器具製造業、輸送用機械器具製造業、船舶製造又は修理業及び計量器、光学機械、時計等製造業を除く。） 5/1,000; 57 電気機械器具製造業 3/1,000; 58 輸送用機械器具製造業（船舶製造又は修理業を除く。） 4/1,000; 59 船舶製造又は修理業 23/1,000; 60 計量器、光学機械、時計等製造業（電気機械器具製造業を除く。） 2.5/1,000; 64 貴金属製品、装身具、皮革製品等製造業 3.5/1,000; 61 その他の製造業 6/1,000; 71 交通運輸事業 4/1,000; 72 貨物取扱事業（港湾貨物取扱事業及び港湾荷役業を除く。） 8.5/1,000; 73 港湾貨物取扱事業（港湾荷役業を除く。） 9/1,000; 74 港湾荷役業 12/1,000; 81 電気、ガス、水道又は熱供給の事業 3/1,000; 95 農業又は海面漁業以外の漁業 13/1,000; 91 清掃、火葬又はと畜の事業 13/1,000; 93 ビルメンテナンス業 6/1,000; 96 倉庫業、警備業、消毒又は害虫駆除の事業又はゴルフ場の事業 6.5/1,000; 97 通信業、放送業、新聞業又は出版業 2.5/1,000; 98 卸売業・小売業、飲食店又は宿泊業 3/1,000; 99 金融業、保険業又は不動産業 2.5/1,000; 94 その他の各種事業 3/1,000; 90 船舶所有者の事業 42/1,000. Workers’ compensation is compulsory for every business employing a worker (労働者災害補償保険法 §3), so payroll refuses without it.

facts.label: メリット制による労災保険率 (per 1,000, as notified)
facts.description: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(3) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): for a qualifying business the Minister raises or lowers the 労災保険率 within ±40% by its own benefit record. Record the rate per 1,000 the 労働局 notified for the 保険年度, only when one was notified; otherwise the table rate of the business type applies.

facts.label: 電算機計算の特例 (月額表甲欄)
facts.description: 平成24年財務省告示第116号 (https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/data/18.pdf): true where the payer computes monthly 甲欄 withholding by the 電子計算機等 method instead of reading the 月額表; the difference is settled at the 年末調整.

facts.label: 36協定 特別条項
facts.description: 労働基準法 §36(5): a 36協定 with a special clause may exceed the 45-hour month and 360-hour year 限度時間 in up to six months a year, within 720 hours a year and under 100 hours a month with statutory-holiday work (§36(6)). Unrecorded is no special clause.

terms_facts.label: 年間所定労働時間 (annual scheduled hours)
terms_facts.description: 労働基準法施行規則 §19(1)(iv) and 最低賃金法施行規則 §2(1)(iii): a monthly wage's hourly rate is the wage over the month's scheduled hours, or the annual average monthly scheduled hours where the months differ — the contract's scheduled hours for the year, net of breaks, scheduled rest days and holidays (e.g. 2,064). The ordinary divisor and the minimum-wage month both read it ÷ 12; no default stands in for it.

terms_facts.label: 源泉徴収税額表の欄 (甲/乙/丙)
terms_facts.description: 所得税法 §185(1) and §194 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2511.htm): KOU (甲欄) only where the worker filed the 給与所得者の扶養控除等（異動）申告書 with this payer; HEI (丙欄) for 日雇賃金 — daily-paid work of at most two months' continuous employment; otherwise OTSU (乙欄). Unrecorded is no declaration: OTSU, the statute's column for a payer without the declaration.

terms_facts.label: 扶養親族等の数
terms_facts.description: The number of 源泉控除対象配偶者 and 控除対象扶養親族 the 扶養控除等申告書 declares, plus one for each disability, widow/single-parent or working-student status the table's notes add (NTA 月額表 備考). Required with KOU.

terms_facts.label: 住民税の徴収方法
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-3–§321-5: an employer designated by the municipality special-collects (SPECIAL, 特別徴収) the resident tax the municipality notifies, one twelfth a month from June to the following May; ORDINARY (普通徴収) where the municipality notice leaves collection to the worker. Record from the municipality's 特別徴収税額の決定通知書 (e.g. https://www.city.shinjuku.lg.jp/hoken/file04_04_00001.html).

terms_facts.label: 住民税 6月分 (最初の徴収月の額)
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-5(1), §20-4-2(6), (8): the first installment the notice states — June for the ordinary notice (a later notice: its resident_tax_first_month); it carries the fractions under JPY100 of the annual amount, so it differs from the rest. A new terms row each June carries the next notice.

terms_facts.label: 住民税 7月分以降
terms_facts.description: The installment of every later month to May the same notice states (7月分以降 for the ordinary notice).

terms_facts.label: 特別徴収税額通知 (municipality, fiscal year)
terms_facts.description: The notifying municipality and 年度 of the notice the two amounts transcribe.

terms_facts.label: 住民税 特別徴収税額通知の年度 (西暦)
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-4, §321-5(1): the 年度 of the notice as a Gregorian year (令和8年度 = 2026): its installments are withheld from pay paid from June of that year to May of the next. Payroll refuses a pay date outside it.

terms_facts.label: 住民税 最初の徴収月
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-5(1): 6 for the ordinary May notice; for a notice received later (a joiner switching to special collection, a changed amount) the month after the notice, from which its first installment (resident_tax_june_amount) and then resident_tax_monthly_amount run to May.

terms_facts.label: 通勤: 1か月当たりの合理的な運賃等の額
terms_facts.description: 所得税法施行令 §20の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2582.htm): the monthly fare of the most economic and reasonable transit route (定期券 equivalent); 0 where the worker does not commute by transit. The untaxed 通勤手当 is at most JPY150,000 a month.

terms_facts.label: 通勤: 交通用具を使用する片道の通勤距離 (km)
terms_facts.description: 所得税法施行令 §20の2(2) (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm): the one-way distance commuted by car, bicycle or other vehicle; under 2 km the vehicle part is taxable. Unrecorded is no vehicle commute.

terms_facts.label: 通勤: 駐車場等の1か月当たりの料金
terms_facts.description: 令和8年度税制改正 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm): from allowances due 1 April 2026, the monthly fee the worker ordinarily bears for a qualifying parking place near the workplace or the station used, added to the vehicle limit up to JPY5,000.

terms_facts.label: 社宅・寮の貸与 (employee)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-41, 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): true where the employer lets company housing to this employee (not an 役員, not a cash housing allowance, which is plain pay).

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 建物の固定資産税の課税標準額 (その年度)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the building’s 固定資産税課税標準額 for the year, also where the employer leases it.

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 建物の総床面積 (m²)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the building’s total floor area.

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 敷地の固定資産税の課税標準額 (その年度)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the site’s 固定資産税課税標準額 for the year.

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 使用人から受け取る家賃 (月額)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-47 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the monthly rent the employee pays; at least 50% of the 賃貸料相当額 leaves the housing untaxed, less is taxed on the difference.

terms_facts.label: 要介護状態の対象家族の数
terms_facts.description: 育児・介護休業法 §16-5(1): the 対象家族 in a 要介護状態 the worker cares for; two or more give 10 介護休暇 days a year instead of 5. Unrecorded is none.

terms_facts.label: 特定最低賃金の適用除外 (outside the specific minimum wage’s coverage)
terms_facts.description: Each 特定最低賃金 decision names the workers it does not cover beyond its age bounds (the SPECIFIC_MW row’s columns): typically those within a stated period after hire learning the skill (雇入れ後一定期間未満の技能習得中の者) and those mainly doing the light tasks it lists (清掃・片付け等). Record true where the decision’s own exclusion reaches this worker; unrecorded is covered (the recorded default: the order applies to the industry’s workers). Only the regional floor then binds.

obligations.description: Conclude a written 時間外・休日労働に関する協定 (36協定) with the majority union or majority representative and file it with the labour standards office before any overtime or statutory holiday work; renew it before it lapses.
obligations.trigger: Any planned overtime beyond 8 h/day or 40 h/week, or work on the statutory rest day
obligations.timing: Before the first such hour; the agreement's period (at most a year in practice) sets renewal
obligations.authority: 労働基準法 §36(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049)

obligations.description: Where a worker’s annual paid leave grant is 10 days or more, designate the timing of 5 of those days (after hearing the worker) within one year of the grant date, less the days the worker took or planned leave gave; keep the 年次有給休暇管理簿 (timing, days, base date per worker) for the grant period and five years after.
obligations.trigger: An ANNUAL_LEAVE grant of 10 days or more; the grant date is the hire day and each hire anniversary (the recorded 前倒し default)
obligations.timing: Within one year of each grant date; the register kept five years after the grant period (three during the transition)
obligations.authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §39(7)–(8); 労働基準法施行規則 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322M40000100023) §24-5, §24-6, §24-7

exit_facts.label: 退職時の賃金支払請求
exit_facts.description: 労働基準法 §23(1): true where the worker (or, on death, the entitled person) requested payment of the wages due; they are then payable within seven days. Unrecorded is no request: the ordinary pay day.

exit_facts.label: 退職所得の受給に関する申告書
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §201(1), (3) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2732.htm): true where the worker submitted the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 before the retirement payment, so the payer withholds on the 退職所得控除 and the 1/2 rules; unrecorded is none, and §201(3) withholds 20.42% of the whole payment.

exit_facts.label: 退職所得控除の勤続年数
exit_facts.description: 所得税法施行令 §69 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340CO0000000096): the service years the 退職所得控除 reads — continuous service to the retirement day, with the §69(1)(i)イ–ハ additions (earlier service with this payer, service elsewhere this payer’s allowance counts) and exclusions (a period an earlier allowance from this payer settled); a part year is one year. Unrecorded is this stint from its first day through the last, a part year one year.

exit_facts.label: 役員等勤続年数
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(5) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 施行令 §69の2: the years served as an 役員等 (法人税法 §2(xv) officer, legislator, public servant). Five or less over the whole service makes the payment a 特定役員退職手当等 (no halving). 0 for an employee.

exit_facts.label: 障害者になったことに直接基因する退職
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(6)(iii); 施行令 §71: true where the worker became disabled while employed and retired having worked not at all or hardly since; adds JPY1,000,000 to the 退職所得控除.

exit_facts.label: 退職所得控除の調整年数 (前の退職手当等との重複期間)
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(6)(i); 施行令 §70 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340CO0000000096; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2732.htm): the years whose deduction is taken off — the service an earlier allowance counted into this one (§70(1)(i)), or the overlap with an allowance received in the previous four years (nine years for an allowance received from 1 January 2026 where a 確定拠出年金 lump sum from 2026 was received in the previous nine; nineteen years for a DC lump sum paid this year), each fraction of a year dropped (§70(3)) and shortened by §70(2) where that allowance fell short of its own deduction. As the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 states.

exit_facts.label: 支払済みの他の退職手当等 (同年分)
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §201(1)(ii); 地方税法 §328-6(1)(ii): an allowance payable this year already paid (by this or another payer), as the declaration states; combined with this payment.

exit_facts.label: 支払済みの他の退職手当等の源泉徴収税額
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §201(1)(ii): the income tax (with 復興特別所得税) withheld or due on that allowance, deducted from the combined tax.

exit_facts.label: 支払済みの他の退職手当等の特別徴収税額 (住民税)
exit_facts.description: 地方税法 §328-6(1)(ii): the 退職所得割 (municipal and prefectural) withheld or due on that allowance, deducted from the combined tax.

exit_facts.label: 支払済みの他の退職手当等の区分
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(4)–(5), §201(1)(ii)イ–ニ: 一般, 短期 or 特定役員退職手当等. A different kind from this payment needs 施行令 §71-2 and is refused.

exit_facts.label: 支払年の1月1日に国内に住所
exit_facts.description: 地方税法 §50-2, §328 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226): the 退職所得割 is levied by the municipality and prefecture of the address on 1 January of the year the allowance is payable; false where the worker had no address in Japan that day (none is withheld). Unrecorded is an address in Japan (recorded default for a RESIDENT).

exit_facts.label: 住民税 特別徴収の退職時の取扱い
exit_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-5(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226; Yokohama https://www.city.yokohama.lg.jp/kurashi/koseki-zei-hoken/zeikin/jigyosya/shizei/choshu/kirikaeiraisyo.html): LUMP_SUM withholds the remaining installments to May in one amount from the final pay where it exceeds them (the worker’s request from June to December; required from January to April); TRANSFER where the new employer continues the special collection (特別徴収継続); ORDINARY where the rest passes to 普通徴収 (June–December only). Unrecorded is no request from June to December and LUMP_SUM from January to April. File the 給与所得者異動届出書 by the tenth of the next month either way.

住宅 1人1か月 総床面積1平方メートル当たり (JPY), from 1 October 2026

worksite_facts.label: 特定最低賃金の適用 (the specific minimum wage this establishment’s industry falls under)
worksite_facts.description: 最低賃金法 §15–§19 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334AC0000000137): a prefecture’s 特定最低賃金 binds workers of the establishments of the industry it names; MHLW industry table (https://saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp/table/page_indlist_nationallist.html). Record the determination code (JP-SFnnn) whose industry the establishment’s main business is in; unrecorded is none. The worksite’s region must be the determination’s prefecture, or no specific floor applies.

duty_types.label: 源泉所得税・復興特別所得税の納付
duty_types.authority: 所得税法 §183(1), §199 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): the tax withheld on wages and retirement pay is paid by the 10th of the month after payment (NTA No.2505 https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2505.htm). The 納期の特例 (§216, under ten regular payees, approved) half-yearly cycle is not declared here.
duty_types.subject: RUN

evidence.label: 納付: the day filed or paid
納付: the receipt, 受付番号 or 納付書 reference

duty_types.label: 個人住民税 特別徴収税額の納入
duty_types.authority: 地方税法 §321-5(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226): the special-collection amount withheld each month is paid in by the 10th of the following month; §328-5(1) the same for the 退職所得 separate tax. The §321-5-2 納期の特例 (June–November by 10 December, December–May by 10 June) is not declared here.
duty_types.subject: RUN

evidence.label: 納入: the day filed or paid
納入: the receipt, 受付番号 or 納付書 reference

duty_types.label: 被保険者賞与支払届
duty_types.authority: 健康保険法施行規則 §27, 厚生年金保険法施行規則 §19-5 (JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/hokenryo/hoshu/20141203.html): within five days of the day a bonus is paid.
duty_types.subject: RUN

evidence.label: 賞与支払届: the day filed or paid
賞与支払届: the receipt, 受付番号 or 納付書 reference

duty_types.label: 健康保険・厚生年金保険 被保険者資格取得届
duty_types.authority: 健康保険法施行規則 §24, 厚生年金保険法施行規則 §15 (JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/jigyosho-hiho/hihokensha1/20150422.html): within five days of the 資格取得日 (the hire day for a worker covered from hire).
duty_types.subject: EMPLOYMENT

evidence.label: 資格取得届: the day filed or paid

bands.label: OT-1.25X
bands.take_hours: (normal_hours + hours_beyond_normal > limits.normal_day ? hours_beyond_normal - (limits.normal_day > normal_hours ? limits.normal_day - normal_hours : 0.0) : 0.0)

limits.authority: 労働基準法 §32(2): 一日について八時間を超えて、労働させてはならない
労働基準法 §32(1): 一週間について四十時間を超えて、労働させてはならない
労働基準法 §36(3)–(4): the 36協定 限度時間 of 45 hours a month (a reported ceiling; a special clause may exceed it in up to six months)
労働基準法 §36(4): 限度時間 of 360 hours a year (a reported ceiling)
労働基準法 §36(5): even under a special clause, overtime of at most 720 hours a year
労働基準法 §36(6)(ii): overtime plus statutory holiday work under 100 hours in a month (百時間未満; the ceiling report counts 100 itself as within)

wages.authority: 最低賃金法 §9–§10 and §4(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334AC0000000137): each prefecture's 地域別最低賃金 is an hourly amount binding the work performed at a workplace in that prefecture (§13: a dispatched worker takes the client workplace's). `by_region` holds that hourly amount per prefecture, read at the worksite the terms record (`workplace_keyed`); `scale` restates it in the contract's month — 最低賃金法施行規則 §2(1)(iii) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334M50002000016) divides a monthly wage by the month's scheduled hours, or by the annual average monthly scheduled hours where months differ, so the hourly floor × annual scheduled hours ÷ 12 is the month's floor; a daily or hourly rate reaches the same comparison through `terms.monthly_basic` on the ordinary divisor. §4(2): a contract below the floor is void to that extent and the floor applies in its place (`substitutes_below`). The comparison wage is the scheduled pay (施行規則 §1; MHLW https://saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp/point/page_point_targetwages.html: bonuses, overtime/holiday/night premiums and commuting, family and attendance allowances are outside it) — the fixed allowances count (`floor_includes_fixed_allowances`) until an allowance catalogue names the excluded classes. Amounts and 発効日: MHLW H14–R8 workbook (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/11200000/001753407.xlsx) and MHLW's quick table (https://saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp/table/page_list_nationallist.php, read 2026-09-30); the workbook prints six 令和7年度 dates with the previous year (秋田 03-31, 福島/徳島/大分/熊本 01-01, 群馬 03-01), the quick table prints 令和8 for each. 令和8年度 successors: MHLW national list (https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/11200000/001753404.pdf) and the quick table (“令和8.MM.DDからは”). 特定最低賃金 (work_rules.derived_lines SPECIFIC_MINIMUM_WAGE): 最低賃金法 §6(1) — where a worker is under both a regional and a specific minimum wage the higher binds; §4(2) substitutes it for a lower contract term. The SPECIFIC_MW row of the worksite’s prefecture and recorded industry (worksite_facts.specific_mw_industry) gives an hourly amount; restated in the month over the annual scheduled hours (施行規則 §2(1)(iii), as the regional floor), the month’s wage (basic already raised to the regional floor, plus the fixed allowances) is topped up to it in the share of the month the salary line pays. Covered ages and the order’s own exclusions (terms_facts.specific_mw_excluded) are read per row; the recorded default is 18 to under 65, the usual 適用除外 of MHLW’s decisions.

work_rules.authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §32: normal hours are at most 40 a week and 8 a day (`normal_hours`, limits `normal_day` and `weekly_normal`). §37(1) with 労働基準法第三十七条第一項の時間外及び休日の割増賃金に係る率の最低限度を定める政令 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/406CO0000000005): hours beyond the statutory day are paid at least 25% above the ordinary hourly wage, and work on the §35 statutory rest day at least 35% — a REST code marked `statutory` is that day (`statutory_rest`); its hours are holiday work, never overtime. §37(4): 22:00–05:00 adds at least 25% on top (`night_premium`), so night overtime is 50% and night holiday work 60%. Hours past the contract's shorter scheduled day up to the statutory 8 (法内残業) owe the ordinary rate only (`IN-LAW-1.0X`). Owner rule 2026-09-28, law silent: work on a non-statutory rest day, a national holiday or an unrostered day is treated as outside a full 40-hour week and paid at 125% — never below §37, although a short week would owe 100% for hours still inside 40. §41(2): a 管理監督者 (work_classification SUPERVISORY_MANAGER) is outside the hours, rest and overtime/holiday rules (`overtime_when`), not the night premium. §36(4)–(6): the 36協定 ordinary limits 45 h a month and 360 h a year, and the absolute limits 720 h a year of overtime and under 100 h a month of overtime plus statutory holiday work, are reported ceilings here (planned hours beyond them are kept, paid at the same band, as INCENTIVE), not refusals. 施行規則 §19(1)(iv) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322M40000100023): a monthly wage's hourly rate is the wage ÷ the month's scheduled hours, or the annual average monthly scheduled hours where months differ: `ordinary_divisor_days` spreads the month over annual scheduled hours ÷ 12 ÷ the daily hours. Rounding: MHLW 昭和63年3月14日 基発第150号 (as restated https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/yamaguchi-roudoukyoku/content/contents/001988747.pdf) tolerates rounding the hourly rate and each premium amount at 50 銭 (under 50 銭 down, 50 銭 and over up); the bands price on the hourly rate rounded to the yen (`round(x, 1, 'HALF_UP')`), and every yen line rounds half-up at JPY's minor unit (通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 §3, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/362AC0000000042).

derived_lines.when: has(worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry) && table('SPECIFIC_MW', worksite.region, worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry) != null && terms.monthly_basic > 0.0 && double(employee.age) >= double(table('SPECIFIC_MW', worksite.region, worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry).covered_from_age) && double(employee.age) < double(table('SPECIFIC_MW', worksite.region, worksite.facts.specific_mw_industry).covered_below_age) && !terms.facts.specific_mw_excluded

final_pay_deadlines.authority: 労働基準法 §23(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049): on the death or retirement of a worker, wages are paid within seven days of the entitled person's request. The statute counts from the request; the recorded default (owner rule 2026-09-28) counts from the last day, the earliest a request can be made, so the warning is never late. Without a request the ordinary §24 pay day applies.

worksite_coverage.authority: 最低賃金法 §9, §13 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334AC0000000137): the regional minimum wage is set per prefecture and binds work at a workplace there; a worksite must name one of the 47 prefectures `work_rules.wages.by_region` keys, or payroll refuses.

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation on e-Gov 法令検索, the 官報, or the table the ministry or labour bureau itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date.
laws.e-gov.go.jp — 法令検索: /law/<法令ID> is the current text with its amendment history. IDs: 労働基準法 322AC0000000049, 労働基準法施行規則 322M40000100023, 割増賃金率の政令 406CO0000000005, 最低賃金法 334AC0000000137, 最低賃金法施行規則 334M50002000016, 所得税法 340AC0000000033, 通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 362AC0000000042.
mhlw.go.jp / saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp / jsite.mhlw.go.jp — 最低賃金: the H14–R8 workbook (content/11200000/001753407.xlsx), the 令和8年度 national list (001753404.pdf), the quick table /table/page_list_nationallist.php (current amount, 発効日, and “からは” the next); each prefectural labour bureau publishes its own decision and 官報公示 date.
nta.go.jp — 源泉徴収: taxanswer/gensen/2511 (税額表の区分), /publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo<year>/ (the year's tables).

Finding changes (every run): each August–September read MHLW's 地域別最低賃金 答申 release and the quick table; a 答申 amount is pending until the prefectural director's decision is published (最低賃金法 §14(2): effective 30 days after publication, or later as stated). Read e-Gov's 新着 (laws.e-gov.go.jp) for 労働基準法 and its 施行規則. Every December read nta.go.jp for the next year's 源泉徴収税額表.
kyoukaikenpo.or.jp / nenkin.go.jp — 社会保険: 協会けんぽ's 保険料額表 workbook for the year (/assets/r<N>ippan3.xlsx; branch rates, care rate, the 50 grades and the rounding and bonus notes), JPS 保険料額表 (/service/kounen/hokenryo/ryogaku/ryogakuhyo/) for 厚生年金 and 拠出金, こども家庭庁 for the 子ども・子育て支援金 rate. Each February read the next 年度's 協会けんぽ rates (they apply from the March insurance month, collected with April pay) and the 支援金 rate for April; a version's rates are those of the insurance month its pay months collect.

facts.label: メリット制による労災保険率 (per 1,000, as notified)
facts.description: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 §12(3) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/344AC0000000084): for a qualifying business the Minister raises or lowers the 労災保険率 within ±40% by its own benefit record. Record the rate per 1,000 the 労働局 notified for the 保険年度, only when one was notified; otherwise the table rate of the business type applies.

facts.label: 電算機計算の特例 (月額表甲欄)
facts.description: 平成24年財務省告示第116号 (https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf; 令和7年分 https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2024/data/18.pdf): true where the payer computes monthly 甲欄 withholding by the 電子計算機等 method instead of reading the 月額表; the difference is settled at the 年末調整.

facts.label: 36協定 特別条項
facts.description: 労働基準法 §36(5): a 36協定 with a special clause may exceed the 45-hour month and 360-hour year 限度時間 in up to six months a year, within 720 hours a year and under 100 hours a month with statutory-holiday work (§36(6)). Unrecorded is no special clause.

terms_facts.label: 年間所定労働時間 (annual scheduled hours)
terms_facts.description: 労働基準法施行規則 §19(1)(iv) and 最低賃金法施行規則 §2(1)(iii): a monthly wage's hourly rate is the wage over the month's scheduled hours, or the annual average monthly scheduled hours where the months differ — the contract's scheduled hours for the year, net of breaks, scheduled rest days and holidays (e.g. 2,064). The ordinary divisor and the minimum-wage month both read it ÷ 12; no default stands in for it.

terms_facts.label: 源泉徴収税額表の欄 (甲/乙/丙)
terms_facts.description: 所得税法 §185(1) and §194 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2511.htm): KOU (甲欄) only where the worker filed the 給与所得者の扶養控除等（異動）申告書 with this payer; HEI (丙欄) for 日雇賃金 — daily-paid work of at most two months' continuous employment; otherwise OTSU (乙欄). Unrecorded is no declaration: OTSU, the statute's column for a payer without the declaration.

terms_facts.label: 扶養親族等の数
terms_facts.description: The number of 源泉控除対象配偶者 and 控除対象扶養親族 the 扶養控除等申告書 declares, plus one for each disability, widow/single-parent or working-student status the table's notes add (NTA 月額表 備考). Required with KOU.

terms_facts.label: 住民税の徴収方法
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-3–§321-5: an employer designated by the municipality special-collects (SPECIAL, 特別徴収) the resident tax the municipality notifies, one twelfth a month from June to the following May; ORDINARY (普通徴収) where the municipality notice leaves collection to the worker. Record from the municipality's 特別徴収税額の決定通知書 (e.g. https://www.city.shinjuku.lg.jp/hoken/file04_04_00001.html).

terms_facts.label: 住民税 6月分 (最初の徴収月の額)
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-5(1), §20-4-2(6), (8): the first installment the notice states — June for the ordinary notice (a later notice: its resident_tax_first_month); it carries the fractions under JPY100 of the annual amount, so it differs from the rest. A new terms row each June carries the next notice.

terms_facts.label: 住民税 7月分以降
terms_facts.description: The installment of every later month to May the same notice states (7月分以降 for the ordinary notice).

terms_facts.label: 特別徴収税額通知 (municipality, fiscal year)
terms_facts.description: The notifying municipality and 年度 of the notice the two amounts transcribe.

terms_facts.label: 住民税 特別徴収税額通知の年度 (西暦)
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-4, §321-5(1): the 年度 of the notice as a Gregorian year (令和8年度 = 2026): its installments are withheld from pay paid from June of that year to May of the next. Payroll refuses a pay date outside it.

terms_facts.label: 住民税 最初の徴収月
terms_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-5(1): 6 for the ordinary May notice; for a notice received later (a joiner switching to special collection, a changed amount) the month after the notice, from which its first installment (resident_tax_june_amount) and then resident_tax_monthly_amount run to May.

terms_facts.label: 通勤: 1か月当たりの合理的な運賃等の額
terms_facts.description: 所得税法施行令 §20の2 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2582.htm): the monthly fare of the most economic and reasonable transit route (定期券 equivalent); 0 where the worker does not commute by transit. The untaxed 通勤手当 is at most JPY150,000 a month.

terms_facts.label: 通勤: 交通用具を使用する片道の通勤距離 (km)
terms_facts.description: 所得税法施行令 §20の2(2) (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm): the one-way distance commuted by car, bicycle or other vehicle; under 2 km the vehicle part is taxable. Unrecorded is no vehicle commute.

terms_facts.label: 通勤: 駐車場等の1か月当たりの料金
terms_facts.description: 令和8年度税制改正 (https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2026tsukin/index.htm): from allowances due 1 April 2026, the monthly fee the worker ordinarily bears for a qualifying parking place near the workplace or the station used, added to the vehicle limit up to JPY5,000.

terms_facts.label: 社宅・寮の貸与 (employee)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-41, 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): true where the employer lets company housing to this employee (not an 役員, not a cash housing allowance, which is plain pay).

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 建物の固定資産税の課税標準額 (その年度)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the building’s 固定資産税課税標準額 for the year, also where the employer leases it.

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 建物の総床面積 (m²)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the building’s total floor area.

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 敷地の固定資産税の課税標準額 (その年度)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-45 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the site’s 固定資産税課税標準額 for the year.

terms_facts.label: 社宅: 使用人から受け取る家賃 (月額)
terms_facts.description: 所得税基本通達 36-47 (https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2597.htm): the monthly rent the employee pays; at least 50% of the 賃貸料相当額 leaves the housing untaxed, less is taxed on the difference.

terms_facts.label: 要介護状態の対象家族の数
terms_facts.description: 育児・介護休業法 §16-5(1): the 対象家族 in a 要介護状態 the worker cares for; two or more give 10 介護休暇 days a year instead of 5. Unrecorded is none.

terms_facts.label: 特定最低賃金の適用除外 (outside the specific minimum wage’s coverage)
terms_facts.description: Each 特定最低賃金 decision names the workers it does not cover beyond its age bounds (the SPECIFIC_MW row’s columns): typically those within a stated period after hire learning the skill (雇入れ後一定期間未満の技能習得中の者) and those mainly doing the light tasks it lists (清掃・片付け等). Record true where the decision’s own exclusion reaches this worker; unrecorded is covered (the recorded default: the order applies to the industry’s workers). Only the regional floor then binds.

obligations.description: Conclude a written 時間外・休日労働に関する協定 (36協定) with the majority union or majority representative and file it with the labour standards office before any overtime or statutory holiday work; renew it before it lapses.
obligations.trigger: Any planned overtime beyond 8 h/day or 40 h/week, or work on the statutory rest day
obligations.timing: Before the first such hour; the agreement's period (at most a year in practice) sets renewal
obligations.authority: 労働基準法 §36(1) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049)

obligations.description: Where a worker’s annual paid leave grant is 10 days or more, designate the timing of 5 of those days (after hearing the worker) within one year of the grant date, less the days the worker took or planned leave gave; keep the 年次有給休暇管理簿 (timing, days, base date per worker) for the grant period and five years after.
obligations.trigger: An ANNUAL_LEAVE grant of 10 days or more; the grant date is the hire day and each hire anniversary (the recorded 前倒し default)
obligations.timing: Within one year of each grant date; the register kept five years after the grant period (three during the transition)
obligations.authority: 労働基準法 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322AC0000000049) §39(7)–(8); 労働基準法施行規則 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/322M40000100023) §24-5, §24-6, §24-7

exit_facts.label: 退職時の賃金支払請求
exit_facts.description: 労働基準法 §23(1): true where the worker (or, on death, the entitled person) requested payment of the wages due; they are then payable within seven days. Unrecorded is no request: the ordinary pay day.

exit_facts.label: 退職所得の受給に関する申告書
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §201(1), (3) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2732.htm): true where the worker submitted the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 before the retirement payment, so the payer withholds on the 退職所得控除 and the 1/2 rules; unrecorded is none, and §201(3) withholds 20.42% of the whole payment.

exit_facts.label: 退職所得控除の勤続年数
exit_facts.description: 所得税法施行令 §69 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340CO0000000096): the service years the 退職所得控除 reads — continuous service to the retirement day, with the §69(1)(i)イ–ハ additions (earlier service with this payer, service elsewhere this payer’s allowance counts) and exclusions (a period an earlier allowance from this payer settled); a part year is one year. Unrecorded is this stint from its first day through the last, a part year one year.

exit_facts.label: 役員等勤続年数
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(5) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033); 施行令 §69の2: the years served as an 役員等 (法人税法 §2(xv) officer, legislator, public servant). Five or less over the whole service makes the payment a 特定役員退職手当等 (no halving). 0 for an employee.

exit_facts.label: 障害者になったことに直接基因する退職
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(6)(iii); 施行令 §71: true where the worker became disabled while employed and retired having worked not at all or hardly since; adds JPY1,000,000 to the 退職所得控除.

exit_facts.label: 退職所得控除の調整年数 (前の退職手当等との重複期間)
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(6)(i); 施行令 §70 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340CO0000000096; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2732.htm): the years whose deduction is taken off — the service an earlier allowance counted into this one (§70(1)(i)), or the overlap with an allowance received in the previous four years (nine years for an allowance received from 1 January 2026 where a 確定拠出年金 lump sum from 2026 was received in the previous nine; nineteen years for a DC lump sum paid this year), each fraction of a year dropped (§70(3)) and shortened by §70(2) where that allowance fell short of its own deduction. As the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 states.

exit_facts.label: 支払済みの他の退職手当等 (同年分)
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §201(1)(ii); 地方税法 §328-6(1)(ii): an allowance payable this year already paid (by this or another payer), as the declaration states; combined with this payment.

exit_facts.label: 支払済みの他の退職手当等の源泉徴収税額
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §201(1)(ii): the income tax (with 復興特別所得税) withheld or due on that allowance, deducted from the combined tax.

exit_facts.label: 支払済みの他の退職手当等の特別徴収税額 (住民税)
exit_facts.description: 地方税法 §328-6(1)(ii): the 退職所得割 (municipal and prefectural) withheld or due on that allowance, deducted from the combined tax.

exit_facts.label: 支払済みの他の退職手当等の区分
exit_facts.description: 所得税法 §30(4)–(5), §201(1)(ii)イ–ニ: 一般, 短期 or 特定役員退職手当等. A different kind from this payment needs 施行令 §71-2 and is refused.

exit_facts.label: 支払年の1月1日に国内に住所
exit_facts.description: 地方税法 §50-2, §328 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226): the 退職所得割 is levied by the municipality and prefecture of the address on 1 January of the year the allowance is payable; false where the worker had no address in Japan that day (none is withheld). Unrecorded is an address in Japan (recorded default for a RESIDENT).

exit_facts.label: 住民税 特別徴収の退職時の取扱い
exit_facts.description: 地方税法 §321-5(2) (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/325AC0000000226; Yokohama https://www.city.yokohama.lg.jp/kurashi/koseki-zei-hoken/zeikin/jigyosya/shizei/choshu/kirikaeiraisyo.html): LUMP_SUM withholds the remaining installments to May in one amount from the final pay where it exceeds them (the worker’s request from June to December; required from January to April); TRANSFER where the new employer continues the special collection (特別徴収継続); ORDINARY where the rest passes to 普通徴収 (June–December only). Unrecorded is no request from June to December and LUMP_SUM from January to April. File the 給与所得者異動届出書 by the tenth of the next month either way.

worksite_facts.description: 最低賃金法 §15–§19 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/334AC0000000137): a prefecture’s 特定最低賃金 binds workers of the establishments of the industry it names; MHLW industry table (https://saiteichingin.mhlw.go.jp/table/page_indlist_nationallist.html). Record the determination code (JP-SFnnn) whose industry the establishment’s main business is in; unrecorded is none. The worksite’s region must be the determination’s prefecture, or no specific floor applies.

duty_types.authority: 所得税法 §183(1), §199 (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/340AC0000000033): the tax withheld on wages and retirement pay is paid by the 10th of the month after payment (NTA No.2505 https://www.nta.go.jp/taxes/shiraberu/taxanswer/gensen/2505.htm). duty_types.authority: 健康保険法施行規則 §29, 厚生年金保険法施行規則 §22 (JPS https://www.nenkin.go.jp/service/kounen/jigyosho-hiho/hihokensha1/20150407-01.html): within five days of the 資格喪失日, the day after the last day of employment (健康保険法 §36(ii)); counted from the day after (民法 §140), so the last day plus six.
